changelog: Add support for guphim.* domains and a custom GuPhim extractor in generic_html_link_harvester: update pre-seeded domain mappings in config.py to include guphim.com/.co/.net/.org, detect GuPhim landing pages, parse cdnHost/slug/episode hashes from page HTML/URL, call the GuPhim API to obtain stream links (using curl_cffi), and return a formatted stream option. Also adjust player detection to consider GuPhim page patterns. Tidy up UI layout by adding min-width: 0 to several selectors in static/css/styles.css to prevent overflow issues.
